description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DoTrustedCallbackTrait' that provides functionality to perform and validate trusted callbacks within Drupal's security system, ensuring only predefined methods or trusted interfaces are invoked as callbacks.

methods.name: doTrustedCallback
methods.description: Performs a callback if it is trusted, checking various conditions such as interface implementation, attributes, and class methods, and throws an exception or triggers a warning if the callback is untrusted.
